text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the birthday 
present, Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It suits you perfectly, right, Grass-chan? 
I'm so glad you liked it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Maruzen-san. There's something I'd 
like to ask you, if that's all right.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“—That is a white bamboo tea scoop. And a 
masterpiece crafted by a traditional Kyoto 
master at that.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They supposedly don't offer mail order. 
Which means the only way was to go buy it 
in person, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. I heard from Spe-chan and the 
others. They said you really wanted it, 
Grass-chan."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you'd take good care of it, I 
just, well... you know. It made me want to 
go out for a drive.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Taking advantage of it being my 
birthday, might I ask you to indulge one 
selfish request of mine?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Don't hold back, feel free to 
tell me anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I would love to prepare some tea for 
you right away using the tea scoop you 
gave me."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I felt that hosting a tea gathering where 
we can share a true bond would be the most 
fitting way... to return the warmth you 
have shown me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you inviting me for tea? In that 
case, I'd gladly accept.
